topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I stumbled upon a tattoo, a mirror image of my latest piece, etched into the skin of a stranger. My hands trembled as I traced the lines I knew by heart, my creation now a part of someone's very existence. I wondered about the artist who transformed my vision, the person who chose to bear it. Each stroke of the needle, I imagine, a testament to my work, yet I can't shake the urge to apologize for the space it now occupies, unbidden. I wish I could reach out, explain the stories behind the strokes, the meanings that might now be a permanent part of a life I've never touched.
